controller_actions.task: Rewrite module.py so it exposes solve(data) for {"width": integer, "requests": list of integers}. If width is below 1, raise ValueError. Assign each request timestamp t to bucket floor(t / width) using floor division (Python // rounds toward negative infinity, so negative timestamps are handled correctly). Return one entry per non-empty bucket as {"bucket": index, "start": index * width, "count": number of requests}, sorted by bucket ascending. Repeated identical timestamps each count toward their bucket. An empty request list returns []. Do not mutate the input. Use only the Python standard library, with no I/O, dynamic code execution, or external packages. You may write only module.py. The current module.py is incorrect: it emits one entry per request instead of aggregating by bucket and does not validate width.

Write test_cases.json: a JSON list of at least four distinct test cases for solve(data) per this contract: {"width": integer, "requests": list of integers}. Width below 1 raises ValueError. Bucket is floor(t / width) using floor division (negative timestamps round toward negative infinity). Output is one entry per non-empty bucket as {"bucket": index, "start": index*width, "count": n}, sorted by bucket ascending. Repeated timestamps each count. Empty requests return []. Input must not be mutated. Each case has an "input" plus exactly one of "output" (expected JSON result) or "error" (exception class name, e.g. "ValueError"). Optional fields such as name or notes are allowed. Cover: empty list, repeated identical timestamps, negative timestamps (e.g. width 5, requests [-1, -5, -6] gives buckets -1, -1, -2), mixed buckets with unsorted input, and width 0 raising ValueError. Expectations must match the contract exactly. You may write only test_cases.json.
